title: Station C
desc: Four people, and none of them is the one who knows
setting: The reception desk of a hospital at ten past seven in the evening, and a name you have said out loud only in a stairwell.

steps.speaker: Am Empfang
steps.en: Hello. What is the patient's name?

options.feedback: The surname first, then both. That is what she needs to type and it is all she needs.
True, and it is the answer to the next question, not this one. She asked for a name.

options.en: I am looking for an old woman.
options.feedback: There are four hundred people in this building. Give her the name.
Say it plainly. It is not nothing here, and it is enough to be told the ward.
It would work. It is also a lie that somebody will repeat back to you in a corridor.
It does, and she is not being nosy. She has to decide what she is allowed to tell you.

steps.speaker: Eine Pflegerin
steps.es: Zu wem möchten Sie? Die Besuchszeit ist bald vorbei.
steps.en: Who would you like to see? Visiting time is nearly over.

options.es: Zu Frau Amrein. Ich weiss, es ist spät.
options.en: To Frau Amrein. I know it is late.
options.feedback: Naming the problem yourself is what gets you the ten minutes.
Fine, and she still does not know who you want.
Nobody sent you away. Ten minutes are something too.

steps.speaker: Eine Pflegerin
steps.es: Zimmer dreihundertzwölf. Aber wirklich nur kurz.
steps.en: Room three hundred and twelve. But really only briefly.

options.feedback: Two words, and they are the right two.
You will not get an answer, and she will not hold it against you. Ask the doctor or ask her.
